title: Reports of foreign currency and monetary instrument transactions
definition: The requirement to report transactions in foreign currency and monetary instruments exceeding the stated threshold, conducted by one person in one business day, and to keep the supporting records. The report is a separate obligation from currency transaction reporting and is not satisfied by it.
evidence_to_cite: the report filed, its identifier and the period it covers
the foreign currency and monetary instrument records for the period
the aggregation applied across the person's accounts and locations

sources.citation: Reporting of foreign currency and monetary instrument transactions (31 CFR 1010.370), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
